grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so every source row is a distinct invoice line event and the transaction grain holds without rollup. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id has 2330 distinct values, stock_code 3141), so a derived identity over the tuple invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, unit_price identifies each line; because the duplicate_row_rate is zero, this tuple absorbs no exact duplicates and no aggregation is required.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document number grouping lines into one invoice, with 2330 distinct values such as 489434 and 489435 and a null_rate of 0.0.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag marking cancellation lines, with exactly two distinct values (false, true), a null_rate of 0.0, and corroborated by negative quantities in the samples.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code with 3141 distinct values such as 10002 and 10123C, null_rate 0.0; a code that labels the product on the line.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '11 PC CERAMIC TEA SET POLKADOT'; nullable with 228 nulls (null_rate 0.005098), likely missing when the product record lacks a description.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units on the line, additive across rows, ranging from -1395 to 5184 with negative samples corresponding to cancellation lines; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp the invoice line was recorded, ranging 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with samples resolving to the minute; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit on the line, ranging 0.0 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0; compared and multiplied with quantity across rows, with zero-price samples present.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier (12346 to 18287, 1045 distinct) that labels rather than measures; nullable with null_rate 0.300664, consistent with guest or unregistered purchases.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country with 24 distinct values such as Australia and EIRE, null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row is one invoice line: a single product (stock_code) invoiced in a given quantity at a given unit price on one invoice (invoice_id) at a specific minute (invoiced_at), including cancellation lines flagged by is_cancellation and carrying negative quantities.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, naming the time column, the transaction grain with its derived line identity, and every mapped field's role and type for the deterministic modeling engine that emits the gold models.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; the approved contract is an input to the modeling engine, never a physical table.
limitations: The mapping maps columns and declares grain only: it does not exclude or net out cancellation lines (is_cancellation true, negative quantities down to -1395) or zero-priced lines (unit_price min 0.0), leaving that filtering to consumers; it does not resolve the roughly 30% of rows with null customer_id; and it proposes no quality rules, classifications, service levels, or derived columns beyond the declared line identity.
